study: Multi-quarter timing replication across previously selected Kepler systems
cohort: All 13 targets in real_external_cohort_frozen.json, unchanged (six named planets, seven eclipsing binaries). Kepler-69 b excluded; earlier Q8 outcomes known. No new target selection on model outcomes.

training.preprocessing: Existing per-quarter quality==0 PDCSAP, 301-point median normalization; concatenate and sort. Same broad 0.9–15 day range used in original 13-target study, not narrower target-specific windows.

evaluation.common_duration: Q8-only fitted duration for both models

reporting.primary: For each planned planet-host quarter with both fits and observed data, pass of unchanged phase rule AND named reference period match within 2%. Also report fixed phase-only pass, period relation (exact/half/double/unmatched), all positive/usable windows, depth, and failures. Both fits frozen before opening target evaluation flux; reference periods used only afterward.
reporting.binary_controls: Report phase-only pass and full/half/double period relation, no claim of planet origin.
reporting.comparison: Paired counts of improved, worsened, both, neither among available paired target-quarters; also planned denominators and host-level counts. Stars are not random and repeated quarters within stars are correlated; descriptive counts, no naive independent-event significance.
reporting.failure_policy: Attempt all targets and quarters; if training file absent, report unavailable model(s); if test unavailable retain row; no replacement or fallback period fitting. Period error improvement among both named-period matches reported separately.
reporting.limitations: Reuses previously inspected stars, later quarters not previously evaluated in this project; increased number of observations and baseline confounded; no survey-wide detection or specificity.
